messages:
maya: Quick planning thread 1: per-route cost + tracing hooks + error analytics for a beta. Need gates and a narrow launch.
aj: Keep it tiny: sampled per-route cost + span attrs (route_id, model_id) in canary region. Full invoiced billing later.
frank: Perf risk: adding span attrs could bump p95. I'll run a microbench. Gate p95 delta at 5%.
denise: Customer requires model+route split for beta. Dataset-level is optional. They want canary in their dedicated region.
samira: UI: show 'estimated' tag and 95% CI. Region toggle to scope canary. Minimal mock ready.
elena: Sampling plan: adaptive tiers (0.5/1/5%) by QPS. Low-volume routes get higher sampling.
maya: Acceptance gates: p95 <5% regression; estimator within 20% for top 80% traffic; security signoff for canary. Fallback: disable traces, keep estimates.
aj: Tasks: span schema PR (3d), dataplane propagation (5d).
frank: Perf bench (6d). If overhead >3us/token, cut sampling to 0.5% for non-critical routes.
denise: I'll confirm beta region & legal constraints today.
infra-bot: Heads-up: runtime-kernel v2.14 deploy in 36h, will post perf metrics post-rollout.
maya: Action owners ack?
aj: ack
frank: ack
samira: ack
elena: ack
denise: ack
maya: Thanks. Next check-in 48h after kernel rollout. Ping earlier if blocked.
